image.label: Assets
image.html: Reference photography shipped with the kit, under the approved Assets/Images/ root. One pool, not a set per component: the same file can be avatar's image, card's media or video's poster — the component decides the crop, the file does not. Pass the path exactly as shown; there is no bare-name lookup for images. These are for composing and reviewing a screen. Replace them with the product's own imagery before anything ships.

image.label: Usage rule
image.html: Use only 16:9 or 3:1 image crops. Select the closest approved ratio before delivery; do not introduce one-off image ratios in product surfaces. Avatars, flags, and icons are component primitives, not content imagery.
